title: Fix Debian packaging and remove stale references to "init.lua"

notes.body: These should probably be left in place and prepended with a "previous versions installed this file" comment similar to other files. As I recall, it's possible for old files to be present if someone installs over an old version without uninstalling it first.
This was done in d745a9e12896159b5d4a1cb0ab4d43c065527f29 and that commit inadvertently introduced duplication with this code.

added 12 commits
  • 76107fe3...4e3e55f9 - 11 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • cd4bf3b4 - Fix Debian packaging and remove stale references to "init.lua"
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/11815/diffs?diff_id=771040506&start_sha=76107fe3208370f4606ca2394f71749f47f34a42)
